issues: On Evolve is encoded incorrectly: "Give your leader [defense]+2" was encoded as healLeader 2. It should increase leader defense/max defense, not recover defense; implement a leader-defense-increase effect and use it after discarding an iM@S CG card, then draw 1.

On Super-Evolve is encoded incorrectly: "Change it into an amulet" was encoded as box on the enemy follower. It should transform the selected enemy follower into an amulet-form card; implement support for transforming a target into an amulet/token with granted abilities.

On Super-Evolve is missing the granted ability "At the start of your main phase, deal 2 damage to your leader." The parser instead used grantLastWords. It should grant a start-of-main triggered self-damage ability to the transformed card; implement support for granting triggered abilities such as startOfMain to a target.

On Super-Evolve is encoded incorrectly for "[act] [cost01], discard 2 cards: Bury this." It was encoded as grantLastWords with optionalCost, but this should be a granted activated ability on the transformed card with a 1 PP cost plus discard 2, effect burySelf; implement support for granting activated abilities with costs to another card.
Bane is encoded under a timing "evolve" ability instead of as a printed keyword/passive keyword on the card. Move Bane to keywords or a passive passiveKeywords ability.

Missing continuous clause: "While there's a Lecia, Sky Saber on your field, this follower has Assail." It should be encoded as a passive conditional keyword-grant tied to Lecia, Sky Saber being on your field; implement a condition for a named follower on your field by identity name/card and use it to grant Assail.

Missing continuous clause: "While there's a Lecia, Sky Saber on your field, this follower has Assail." It should be encoded as a passive conditional keyword-grant tied to Lecia, Sky Saber being on your field; implement a condition for a named follower on your field by identity name/card and use it to grant Assail.
Remove the extra keyword "storm". The source card only has a fanfare ability and does not have Storm.

Fanfare damage amount is incorrect: it should be equal to the number of other Passion followers on your field, but parsed uses all Passion followers on your field. Encode a count excluding this follower.

The first effect is overencoded: "Look at the top card of your deck. If it's a Natura card, you may reveal it and add it to your hand" should only operate on the top card, but searchDeckChoose with lookAt 1 can choose that card regardless of whether it is the top card after viewing/filtering semantics. It should be encoded as a top-card peek/check for trait Natura, then optional reveal and add to hand.

The Storm clause is encoded at timing "evolve", but "While there are at least 10 Passion cards in your cemetery, this has Storm" is a passive continuous effect. Change it to a passive ability with condition ownCemeteryTraitMin count 10 granting Storm.

Fanfare condition is encoded with unsupported/incorrect condition type "fieldFollowerMinCost". It should check whether there is an iM@S CG follower on your field with cost 5 or more, then evolve this. Implement a field-card-exists condition with trait and minCost filter, then use autoEvolveIf or an equivalent self-evolve effect.
